tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search Hyperstack docs
tools.description: Search the Hyperstack documentation in natural language. Use this first for any question about a Hyperstack product, feature, workflow, or API. Returns the best-matching passages, each with its page title, breadcrumb, and the docs URL to cite as the source. For a question about a specific API endpoint, request, or response, set resource_type to 'api' (core API) or 'ai_studio_api' (AI Studio API) so only reference pages are searched.

resource_type.description: Narrow results to one product area: vm, cluster, volume, networking, billing, ai_studio, hardware, api, ai_studio_api

tools.name: get_page
tools.title: Get a docs page
tools.description: Fetch the content of one documentation page as Markdown, by its docs URL or /docs/... path (as returned by search_docs). Use it when the answer needs the complete parameter table, code example, or step-by-step procedure rather than a passage. Long pages come back as their intro plus a list of sections; pass `section` to read one.

path.description: Docs URL or path, e.g. https://docs.hyperstack.cloud/docs/virtual-machines/spot/ or docs/virtual-machines/spot

section.description: Optional: the heading of one section to return instead of the whole page (case-insensitive; a prefix is enough), or 'all' to force the whole page. Pages longer than 20,000 characters return their intro and a section list unless a section (or 'all') is given.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.title: List docs sections
tools.description: List the documentation table of contents: every page title with its URL, optionally narrowed to one product area (vm, cluster, volume, networking, billing, ai_studio, hardware, api, ai_studio_api). Use it to see what is documented, or to find the right page when a search is too vague.

filter.description: Product area filter: vm, cluster, volume, networking, billing, ai_studio, hardware, api, ai_studio_api, or 'all' (default)

tools.name: lookup_error
tools.title: Look up an API error
tools.description: Look up a Hyperstack API error by HTTP status code, error_reason value, or the error message text, and get when it occurs, the fix, and a link to the reference. Use it when a user pastes an API error or asks why a request failed.

error_message.description: HTTP status code, error_reason value, or raw error message, e.g. '401', 'not_found', 'out of stock'

tools.name: get_flavor_info
tools.title: GPU flavor specifications
tools.description: Get GPU flavor specifications (GPU model and count, CPUs, RAM, disks, regions, and supported features) from a natural-language hardware question or a GPU model filter. Use it before recommending hardware. It documents specifications only: it does not report current stock or prices.

query.description: Natural language hardware query, e.g. 'fastest single-GPU flavor', 'cheapest with NVLink', '8 GPU setup'

gpu_model.description: GPU model filter: B300, B200, H200, H100, A100, RTX PRO 6000, L40, RTX A6000, RTX A4000, CPU Only
